Hello everyone! My name is Kris. I'm a CS/Math/English undergraduate student at The University of Waterloo. My interests lie in programming languages, system verification, and mathematics. I want to get more familiar with Lean, so I challenged myself to formalize the Shapley-Folkman lemma.

I hope to continue contributing to my fields of interest through open-source contributions and graduate school!
Hi, I’m also an undergrad at Waterloo :wave:
